We compute measures of similarity between the synthetic data generated by the DP-trained T5 models against the original data. Since the synthetic data is one-to-one generated from the original data, we can compute BLEU scores to evaluate similarity. We also compute the MAUVE scores, shown to be more capable of comparing similarity of text distributions.
